text:
maria: Heads-up — PR #8231 fixes the tokenization crash in the serving runtime. We need 2x approvals before the 18:00 UTC deploy cutoff (~45m). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8231 :pray:

devon: on it, pinging @kevin for a second pair. quick Q — does this touch KV cache layout or just the tokenizer path?

kevin: i'll take a look in ~15m. looks isolated to tokenizer but will confirm. also pls add a changelog note if you haven't.

maria: tests are green on CI (all checks passed), rebased onto main, added a one-line changelog in the last commit. Ran unit + integration.

infra-bot: Heads up — deploy-freeze window begins at 18:00 UTC. Any merges after that will be queued until the window opens.

kevin: confirmed no KV shape changes. left a tiny nit about a log message (non-blocking). giving 1st LGTM. :white_check_mark:

devon: running a quick perf smoke locally, no regression observed on 2 requests/s baseline. giving 2nd LGTM. :thumbsup:

maria: Awesome — two LGTMs. Merging now and kicking off canary. Will monitor latency and errors for 15m; rollback plan ready.

ops-bot: Deploy initiated: canary to 2 nodes (tags: canary, release/8231). Tracking at https://deploys.internal/redwood/8231

maria: Canary healthy after 5m — CPU and p95 stable. Promoting to full rollout. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :rocket:
